description: Generate a structured audit working paper JSON from one or more calculations. Aggregates across standards: accounting policies (IAS 8.27A), key estimation uncertainties (IAS 8.31A), calculation workings, journal entries, and a disclosure completeness checklist. Calculation results are NOT stored. Send each calculation in `calculations` as { standard, input } — the input you sent to ifr_calculate, or the ifr_replay payload — and the server recomputes it deterministically (same engine path as ifr_calculate; an expectation in the replay payload is checked and reported per section). A prior ifr_calculate response object is accepted there too. correlationIds are only a shortcut, answered while this server still has the result in hand; an id it does not hold fails the call with CORRELATION_EXPIRED — send that calculation's input instead. Token required; costs 5 credits per included calculation on success (e.g. 3 standards = 15 credits), whichever way it is sent. Failed calls (CORRELATION_EXPIRED, INVALID_VALUE, INLINE_CALCULATION_INVALID) are not charged.

calculations.description: PREFERRED, no expiry: one entry per calculation. Send { standard, input } — the same input you sent to ifr_calculate (or audit.inputEcho) — and the server recomputes it deterministically; the ifr_replay payload ({ standard, input, expectedOutputSha256?, expectedOutput?, xbrlCurrency?, accountingPolicy? }) is accepted too, and its expectation is checked (sections[].replay). A prior ifr_calculate response object (with `data`) is read as given. A refused input fails the whole call (INLINE_CALCULATION_INVALID, with errors[] and index). Mix freely with correlationIds.

correlationIds.description: OPTIONAL shortcut: correlationIds of ifr_calculate calls whose result this server still has in hand (results are not stored; at most 10 minutes, same caller, and not guaranteed). Any id not in hand fails the call with CORRELATION_EXPIRED — send that calculation's input in `calculations` instead. Either this or `calculations` (or both) is required.

entityName.description: Entity name for the workpaper header, e.g. "Acme Kft."

reportingPeriod.description: Reporting period end date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the workpaper header

name: ifr_generate_workpaper
